build.note: modules 9a05d899b; every wasm read with git show at that commit, SHA-256 checked, never a working tree

xm.use: lib/truth.mjs, lib/public.mjs, lib/weather.mjs, lib/sds.mjs, lib/modules.mjs, common.mjs; must equal the commit (git diff --quiet)

xm3.use: common.mjs, lib/ffm.mjs (openFfm, settingsFor, driverRows), config.json fit and environment; must equal the commit

xm6.use: the arm taking its arc and prior; copied into lib/ffm.mjs here with the import paths changed and nothing else
xm6.resultsNote: XM6's README and table.json are read from that origin ref by git show, never from a working tree; cited by receipt and commit

xp2.use: lib/sgp4fit.mjs (S17LP, S17LPc), lib/rsga.mjs (the registered bulletin normalization, read by git show), rows for the P and S17LPc equality; must equal the commit

verdictPool.note: the verdict of group P is on the pool (1,214 windows, 51 ISO weeks); spans and orbit groups printed beside; no pooling across groups

truth.sentinel1: /opt/data/sdn-archive/reference-states/reference (Copernicus POEORB, daily; the last day of each month is missing)
truth.gfz-rso: /opt/data/sdn-archive/xp2-fit-design/reference (XP2's converted GFZOP RSO L64/L65 copies, 2025-10-01..12-28, read only)
truth.rule: XM's lib/truth.mjs: states, jump screen, thinning to 300 s; an arc holding under 90 % of its states is not fitted

arcRule.note: fixed before any fresh score from XM6's spent cells (PLAN.md); every arc runs on every group and is printed

P.label: the newest Space-Track set with EPOCH and CREATION_DATE at or before the cutoff, its B*, propagator/sgp4 AFSPC

A12.label: FFM fitted to the last 12 h

A24.label: FFM fitted to the last 24 h

F2.label: XM3's F2: FFM fitted to the last 72 h

A12c.label: A12 with the arc ending at the set's creation (parity)

A24c.label: A24 with the arc ending at the set's creation (parity)

W12.label: A12 with AGOM's prior sigma at 1000 % of its seed (report only)

S17LP.label: SGP4 fit_elements to the last 17 h with P's B* (data age), XP2's

S17LPc.label: S17LP with the arc ending at the set's creation (the parity clock), XP2's

parity.endsAt: Tc = min(cutoff, the set's CREATION_DATE) (XP2 run.mjs:163)
parity.forecast: from the arc's first state through cutoff + 7 d, scored in the cutoff's bins
parity.weather: the cutoff's condition-O rows for every arm
parity.reportOnly: parity cells restricted to sets created within 6 h of the cutoff

fit.source: experiments/ffm-atmosphere-xm3/config.json fit and environment, unchanged (profile P0: C2's seeds, 10 m per axis, correction tolerance 0.01, sigma edit 5, at most 40 iterations; EGM2008 70 x 70, Sun and Moon DE440s, cannonball SRP, NRLMSISE-00, IERS 2010 solid tides and relativity; RK78 relative 1e-10, absolute 1e-7, initial 60 s, minimum 1e-4 s, maximum 120 s)
fit.arc: the truth's states in [end - L, end] thinned to 300 s (144, 288, 864 states); the reference epoch is the arc's first state
fit.stored: fit record as XM3 stores it, plus the a posteriori sigma of B and AGOM from fit_batch's covariance (fitV3 covariance), a report-only diagnostic
fit.loss: not CONVERGED, a refused forecast, a module refusal (weather rows out of range) or a non-finite state: d = +Infinity in every bin (rule 3), never dropped; B at the bound 0 is converged, counted; an SGP4 fit with B* at or below 0 or unconverged fails its arm (XP2)

weather.condition: O, as issued: XM lib/weather.mjs rowsO (the newest RSGA issued at or before the cutoff, at most 72 h old; GFZ observed before it; trailing 81-day mean) with XM3's driver rule (hold-last through D0 + 8, A1's fill); rows from cutoff - 72 h - 3 d; the cutoff's rows for every arm
weather.rsgaNormalized: /opt/data/sdn-archive/xp2-fit-design/rsga/normalized (every bulletin 2024-11-01..2025-12-31 through experiments/xp2-fit-design/lib/rsga.mjs; a bulletin XM's parser reads is copied unchanged), SHA-256 of each file recorded in the store's inputs; the reader's SHA-256 in build.json

scoring.metric: e: the 3D RMS position error of the bin (km) in the truth's RTN axes (analysis/gp-error-model 0.11.0 pair_statistics, XM's scorer); FFM arms GCRF as returned; P and the SGP4 arms TEME to GCRF by foundation/frames

statistics.d: ln(e_arm / e_ref); arm failed +Infinity; else reference failed -Infinity

rules.1: the interval of the median d wholly below 0
rules.2: the upper bound of the interval of ln(p95_arm / p95_ref) below ln 1.10

S.printed: rule 2 at every lead, not tested
day 7 with a no-loss reading: the upper bound of the median interval below ln 1.10

S.note: a registered prediction of a loss, not a pass

families.rule: a statement is tested only if every earlier statement of its family passed; cells after a stop are printed and labeled not tested

classes.arc: a storm day in the 72 h before the cutoff (one class for every arm)
classes.forecast: a storm day in the forecast through the lead
classes.screening: XM's: Ap at least 50 or any Kp at least 6

storms.postStorm: the five cutoffs after each storm day: the median e of each arm beside P's

f2.against: XM3's stored rows (arm F2, every number)

fresh.against: XP2's stored rows for every window as it runs (rows digest e4cff2a36484); a miss writes DEFECT.json and stops every worker

check.rule: each named arm re-run and compared exactly with the stored row; the table rebuilt equal to the committed table.json byte for byte

integrity: XM's and XM3's windows (2026-01-01..05-31) are spent and not used
C2's hold-out from cutoff 2026-06-01 is barred; Swarm and GRACE-FO truth for 2026-10-31..11-28 is barred
C2's held-out objects and the ISS are out
never read: C2's held-out row files, B2 part 1a and part 5 files, census results, operator-capture content, C3-small's rows, the open-DCA test's rows and results, XM7's results
no fetch; every input is in the archive
no cell is read while the run goes; the table is built after every window is stored
